name: Babel - live translator
author: Kunal Makhija
summary: Uses a Mac audio companion and speech recognition to place short English translations of non-English Zoom speech in chat.
starterPrompt: Explain the Mac setup and permissions for translating my Zoom call into English. Show a test translation before using it in a meeting.
usageNote: Get participants' consent before processing call audio. Review microphone and chat permissions; verify important translations with a speaker or qualified interpreter.
